e.body: Wooz08/study-webpages（2026-09-09）是一个**中文保险考试刷题站点**，两个独立板块：① **偿付能力监管规则**——按偿二代二期（C-ROSS II）**20 份监管规则**组织的 **840 题**题库，题目结构含 rule_no（规则编号）、rule_title（如「实际资本」）、qtype、题干、选项、答案、**解析**（明确引用规则条文，如「第四条规定，实际资本等于认可资产减去认可负债后的余额」）、difficulty 与 type 标注；② **财务管理**——同结构的另一套题库（数据量约 450KB）。两套均为纯静态页面（index + app.js + data.js），可直接本地打开离线刷题。对 RIAA：偿二代是中国偿付能力监管的核心框架，也是中文保险考试（精算师、核保核赔、公司财务）的高频考点，而**按监管规则逐条组织的题库**能直接把「规则文本 → 考点 → 解析」串起来；可与 [[solvency2rfr]]（Solvency II 无风险利率期限结构，欧式对照）、[[eaa-alm-ai-web-session]]、[[qarm]] 一起建立「中/欧偿付能力体系」的对照认知；备考侧与 [[iiqe-1]]（香港保险中介考试）、[[ashk-examination]]、[[actuarial-exam-database]]、[[ruc-nonlife-actuarial]]、[[cn-nonlife-ratemaking-course]] 形成内地+香港的备考资源组合。注意：仓库未声明许可证，星标为 0；题库为自动生成，答案与解析以监管规则原文为准，使用前建议抽查核对。
e.body_en: Wooz08/study-webpages (2026-09-09) is a **Chinese-language insurance exam quiz site** with two independent sections: (1) **solvency regulatory rules** — a **840-question** bank organised by the **20 regulatory rules of C-ROSS II** (China’s second-generation solvency regime), where each item carries rule_no, rule_title (e.g. "actual capital"), qtype, question, options, answer, an **explanation** that cites the rule text explicitly (e.g. "Article 4: actual capital equals admitted assets minus admitted liabilities"), plus difficulty and type tags; (2) **financial management** — a second bank with the same structure (roughly 450KB of data). Both are purely static pages (index + app.js + data.js) that can be opened locally for offline practice. For RIAA: C-ROSS is the core Chinese solvency framework and a frequent topic in Chinese insurance exams (actuarial, underwriting/claims, corporate finance), and a bank **organised rule by rule** ties together "regulation text → exam point → explanation" directly; read it alongside [[solvency2rfr]] (Solvency II risk-free rate term structures, the European counterpart), [[eaa-alm-ai-web-session]] and [[qarm]] to build a China-vs-Europe solvency contrast; on the exam-prep side it combines with [[iiqe-1]] (Hong Kong insurance intermediary exam), [[ashk-examination]], [[actuarial-exam-database]], [[ruc-nonlife-actuarial]] and [[cn-nonlife-ratemaking-course]] into a mainland + Hong Kong resource set. Note: no licence declared, 0 stars; the bank is auto-generated, so answers and explanations should be spot-checked against the original rules before use.
e.body_hk: Wooz08/study-webpages（2026-09-09）是一個**中文保險考試刷題站點**，兩個獨立板塊：① **償付能力監管規則**——按償二代二期（C-ROSS II）**20 份監管規則**組織的 **840 題**題庫，題目結構含 rule_no、rule_title（如「實際資本」）、qtype、題幹、選項、答案、**解析**（明確引用規則條文）、difficulty 與 type 標註；② **財務管理**——同結構的另一套題庫（約 450KB）。兩套均為純靜態頁面（index + app.js + data.js），可直接本地打開離線刷題。對 RIAA：償二代是中國償付能力監管的核心框架，也是中文保險考試的高頻考點，而**按監管規則逐條組織的題庫**能把「規則文本 → 考點 → 解析」串起來；可與 [[solvency2rfr]]、[[eaa-alm-ai-web-session]]、[[qarm]] 一起建立「中/歐償付能力體系」的對照認知；備考側與 [[iiqe-1]]、[[ashk-examination]]、[[actuarial-exam-database]]、[[ruc-nonlife-actuarial]]、[[cn-nonlife-ratemaking-course]] 形成內地+香港的備考資源組合。注意：倉庫未聲明許可證，星標為 0；題庫為自動生成，使用前建議抽查核對。
